name: zmail
description: ZMAIL - 24-hour anonymous email service on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build: npm --prefix worker install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend run build

EMAIL_DOMAIN.description: 收信域名，例如 example.com。必须是已在 Cloudflare 托管、并配好 Email Routing 的域名；填了才会显示完整邮箱地址，留空则只显示前缀。部署后也可在控制台 Worker → 设置 → 变量里修改。
